note: Private campground on Lulu Rd near Petersburg, beside a small spring-fed lake. Google Maps marks it permanently closed (2026-10-22) and its old domain now serves a poker site. --Claude
summary: No operator presence: totempolepark.com serves a 'Dominobet' online-poker page (domain lapsed/hijacked); Google Maps shows 'Totem Pole Park', 16333 Lulu Rd, 4.6 stars / 53 reviews, phone (734) 279-2110 (matches) but marked 'Permanently closed'; the RoverPass page is unclaimed (Claim my Campground, no Instant/Request to Book for this park; its $35-38 rate table is an imported 11/15/2024 record, not a price). A ParkAdvisor review from May 2020 already reported Google's permanent-closed mark and the dead website. Cleared directory-only hookups and pull-through. The family has not stayed here.
